one_liner: A command center for creating bots, integrating apps, and tailoring your Discord server.
auth_notes: Supports basic authentication with credentials as client ID and client secret, OAuth2 bearer tokens, and bot tokens.
verdict_reason: Discord provides a robust REST and WebSocket API with self-serve credentials and clear documentation, making it immediately ready for integration.

extras.rate_limit_note: Rate limits are in place to prevent abuse and ensure the stability of the Discord platform.

evidence.quote: Using basic authentication with credentials as the client ID and client secret found on the OAuth2 page of your app’s settings in the format client_id:client_secret as a Base64 encoded string.
Using an OAuth2 bearer token gained through the OAuth2 API.
You can create a new application by clicking the “New Application” button. After providing a name, you’ll be taken to the application’s settings
Authentication is essential for all API requests. Your bot needs to authenticate itself to verify that it is authorized to perform actions on Discord servers.
